verdict.rationale: Metorial's docs show multiple mechanisms for least-privilege credential issuance: publishable vs secret API keys scoped per project (docs-24), per-environment isolated keys/auth configs (docs-25), tool_filters to restrict which tools an agent session can call (docs-7, docs-16), OAuth-based per-user authorization instead of shared broad credentials (docs-31), and RBAC/SAML/IAM controls so agent access follows org security policy (metorial-gh-1). A runtime probe confirms the live API is key-gated with a Bearer-token contract (metorial-probe-rt-3). One community comment flags that auth documentation in the README lacks clarity (metorial-comm-2), a caveat but not a concrete failure of the scoping capability itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that key scopes are enforced in practice, and clearer first-party documentation of the exact permission granularity available on keys.
